title: The Water Council
description: After contamination and shortage, residents demand a fair system for sharing water. A council is formed.

roles.description: A respected elder who calls the first meeting

choices.label: Elect a water council

effects.title: First election on the surface
effects.description: For the first time since the collapse, survivors vote. The water council is chosen by show of hands.

choices.outcome: Hands are raised in the old mess hall. {{speaker}} is chosen to keep the water ledger.

choices.label: Let the engineers decide
choices.outcome: The engineers take control of the valves. {{dissenter}} calls it theft.

narrative.headline: The Water Council of {{settlement}}
narrative.text: After the sickness, {{speaker}} stood on a crate in the mess hall and asked who should decide how water is shared.
